_about: How reveal works (PE VisionSystem/MovementSystem/CitySystem) plus what that means for inference. WK Fog-of-War page was unreachable (client error) so these rules are PE-only unless marked.

geometry.v: square (Chebyshev) disk of radius r around the unit: all tiles with max(|dx|,|dy|)<=r

unit_vision.v: r = unit.visionRange (1 for most; 2 for Scout skill units: Cloak, Scuba, Scout boat, BabyDragon, FireDragon, IceFortress, Dinghy... ) ; a unit standing on a MOUNTAIN gets max(r,2)
unit_vision.note: WK Combat page: 'Mountains give a two-tile sight radius; Scout units see two tiles in every direction.'

persistence.v: reveal is permanent for the game (a per-player bit is set and never cleared).
persistence.note: PE only ADDS visibility. Whether the real game shows STALE or LIVE info for previously-seen-but-out-of-vision tiles is UNKNOWN (G3) - matters a lot for belief tracking.

movement_reveal.v: reveals along the whole traversed path (using the best vision seen during the move), plus final tile; mountain destination -> radius 2

must_end_on_visible_tile.v: a unit may only END its move on a tile that is revealed to its player

real_game_5x5.v: start score arithmetic needs 25 explored tiles (5x5 around capital); SC: capital near a corner scores 5 less because the corner tile isn't revealed

initial_reveal.PE: territory radius-1 (3x3) tiles revealed + the start unit's radius-1 vision; corners are skipped on Initial reveal

explorer.source: Level-2 city reward 'Explorer' (Luxidoor can't take it in capital) and ruin reward

algorithm.v: 15 steps. Each step: BFS (8-neighbour) dist<=4 over tiles the owner may enter (mountain needs Climbing, shallow water Sailing, ocean Navigation); score tile = 183 - 10*fog_tiles_cleared (plus-shape of 5 tiles, capped at 4) minus 33 if it clears a lighthouse; propagate +100 per BFS layer (3 layers); step to the best adjacent tile, -tie random, +5 penalty for stepping straight back; reveal a plus (centre+4 orthogonal) at every step
algorithm.note: A mirror site says 'up to 20 moves' (OLD, low). PE's 15 and wiki-derived scoring constants agree with each other.

explorer.tie_break_rng: seeded from turn, player, start position
explorer.reveals_ruin_area: ruin 'Explorer' reward only offered if some tile of the 5x5 around the ruin is still hidden

reward.v: first time a player reveals a corner: +1 population in capital (else best city)

lighthouses.monument: Eye of God after discovering all 4
lighthouses.fog_use: Corner tiles are KNOWN: land, no resource, no settlement (non-waterworld). Don't spend belief mass there.

tech_gated_visibility.note: Before the tech, those resources are not displayed. So 'no crop seen' without Organization carries NO information.

enemy_visibility.units_cities: visible only while inside current vision (playerIsCurrentlyVisibleTo checks live tiles)
enemy_visibility.hide_skill: Cloak/Dinghy/Scuba with Hide are invisible to others AFTER they have moved this turn (lastMoveDir != 0); then not targetable and don't project ZoC

retaliation_blind.v: defender cannot retaliate if it cannot see the attacker (WK). PE ignores this.

meeting_reward.v: first time you SEE any unit/city of tribe X: +stars = min(11, 1 + 2*ceil(score_of_X/1000))
meeting_reward.note: resolved at start of your turn and at end of an opponent's turn from live vision; non-Initial reveals trigger it immediately. Real values not verified.

player_visibility_state: PE stores a 16-bit mask per tile (bit i = player i has seen it).
inference_hooks: unseen tile ∈ {prior from map_generation} conditioned on: distance to nearest known settlement, tribe of nearest capital, shallow/deep water, tech gates
every known city/village excludes all unseen cells within Chebyshev<=2 for NEW villages (spacing >=3)
capital ring has >=2 identical resources (C10) -> sharp posterior for rival capital surroundings
map edge tiles never hold villages; corners are lighthouses
number of villages is bounded by (size//3)^2 - capitals, giving a total budget to allocate over unseen area
